The probability of zuph and glimx is 30%. Is the chance of glimx smaller when observing zuph?

We are given:

Using the definition of conditional probability:
$$P(\text{glimx} \mid \text{zuph}) = \frac{P(\text{zuph} \cap \text{glimx})}{P(\text{zuph})} = \frac{0.30}{0.96} = 0.3125$$

*   $P(\neg\text{zuph} \cap \text{glimx}) = 0.03$

$$P(\text{glimx} \mid \neg\text{zuph}) = \frac{P(\neg\text{zuph} \cap \text{glimx})}{P(\neg\text{zuph})} = \frac{0.03}{0.04} = 0.75$$

Comparing the two results:
$$0.3125 < 0.75$$
$$P(\text{glimx} \mid \text{zuph}) < P(\text{glimx} \mid \neg\text{zuph})$$
